description: This is a C source file ('mod_auth_api.c') implementing low-level functions for HTTP authentication backend registration and handling within the lighttpd web server project. It defines functions to manage authentication schemes and backends, perform security checks, and set environment variables related to authentication.

methods.name: const http_auth_scheme_t * http_auth_scheme_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieve an authentication scheme matching the provided name.

methods.name: void http_auth_scheme_set(const http_auth_scheme_t * scheme)
methods.description: Add or update an authentication scheme in the schemes array.

methods.name: const http_auth_backend_t * http_auth_backend_get(const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieve an authentication backend matching the provided name.

methods.name: void http_auth_backend_set(const http_auth_backend_t * backend)
methods.description: Add or update an authentication backend in the backends array.

methods.name: void http_auth_dumbdata_reset(void)
methods.description: Reset all stored authentication schemes and backends to empty states.

methods.name: http_auth_require_t * http_auth_require_init(void)
methods.description: Allocate and initialize a new http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: void http_auth_require_free(http_auth_require_t * const require)
methods.description: Free resources associated with an http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: int http_auth_match_rules(const http_auth_require_t * const require,const char * const user,const char * const group,const char * const host)
methods.description: Check if provided user, group, or host matches the authentication requirements.

methods.name: void http_auth_setenv(request_st * const r,const char * username,size_t ulen,const char * auth_type,size_t alen)
methods.description: Set HTTP environment variables for the remote user and auth type.

methods.name: unsigned int http_auth_digest_len(int algo)
methods.description: Return the length of the digest based on the algorithm used.
